verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Alma publishes an llms.txt at tryalma.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that opens with a summary of the firm, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The probe shows only the opening line, so it is unclear how much content it covers, and the markdown version of the docs (visa-guides.md) returns 404. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth and coverage, markdown/agent-oriented doc variants, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
